content.user_title: Run Structured Deep Research with Gemini
content.value_statement: Complex research can require many searches, source checks, and synthesis steps. This skill documents a Gemini workflow for starting, monitoring, continuing, and formatting research tasks.
actual_capabilities: Documents research workflows for market analysis, literature reviews, technical research, competitive analysis, and due diligence.
Provides command patterns for starting, streaming, polling, waiting for, continuing, and listing Gemini research tasks.
Shows how to request a custom report structure for comparative analysis.
Describes human-readable Markdown, structured JSON, and raw response output modes.
Explains expected task duration, estimated cost, token usage, workflow steps, and exit codes.
limitations: The package contains only SKILL.md; the referenced research script and requirements file are not included.
Research execution requires a separate Gemini API key, compatible implementation, internet access, and paid service availability.
Cost, duration, and token estimates are approximate and can vary by task.
Generated research can contain outdated, incomplete, or incorrect claims and requires source verification.

use_cases.title: Assess a market
use_cases.description: Map competitors, market growth, regulation, and recent forecasts before planning a market entry.

use_cases.title: Review academic evidence
use_cases.description: Build a cited literature overview, compare findings, and identify unresolved questions before deeper source review.

use_cases.title: Compare technologies
use_cases.description: Compare technologies using evidence about capabilities, adoption, maintenance, costs, and operational risks.

prompt_templates.title: Research a topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic]. Provide a concise overview, key dates, major sources, and unresolved questions. Cite every factual claim.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [context]. Evaluate cost, capabilities, risks, and adoption evidence. Finish with a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a market
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [market] in [region] from [start year] to [end year]. Cover size, growth, competitors, regulation, and cited forecasts.

prompt_templates.title: Test a complex decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [decision] using primary and recent sources. Separate evidence from inference, challenge assumptions, identify conflicts, and present confidence-rated conclusions.

output: Executive summary of major development phases and current significance.
Timeline covering origins, releases, governance changes, and ecosystem milestones.
Cited source list with open questions and confidence notes.

output_examples.input: Compare Django and FastAPI for a new internal service.
output: Side-by-side comparison of architecture, performance, ecosystem, maintenance, and team fit.
Evidence-backed tradeoffs for the stated deployment context.
Recommendation with assumptions, risks, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Analyze the European electric vehicle battery market.
output: Market overview with scope, historical context, and cited estimates.
Competitor, supply-chain, policy, and technology analysis.
Forecast scenarios with uncertainty and disputed evidence clearly identified.

best_practices: Define the topic, geography, time range, audience, and decision before starting research.
Request primary and recent sources, then verify important claims against the cited material.
Use continuation requests to challenge assumptions, resolve conflicting evidence, and deepen weak sections.
anti_patterns: Do not submit broad topics without scope, decision criteria, or a required output structure.
Do not treat generated citations or conclusions as verified without opening and checking the sources.
Do not place API keys in prompts, command history, reports, or tracked files.

faq.question: Does this package include the research script?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md, so the documented commands require a separately supplied compatible implementation.

faq.question: Which service does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects Gemini Deep Research access through a Gemini API key and an implementation matching the documented command interface.

faq.question: Which output formats are documented?
faq.answer: The documentation describes human-readable Markdown, structured JSON, and an unprocessed raw response mode.

faq.question: How long does one research task take?
faq.answer: The documentation estimates 2-10 minutes and $2-5 per task, but complexity and provider pricing can change both.

faq.question: Can I continue previous research?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow uses an interaction identifier with continuation, status, wait, stream, and list options.

faq.question: How should I validate the report?
faq.answer: Open cited sources, prefer primary evidence, check publication dates, and distinguish supported facts from model inference.
